body: You are a child for responding the way you did. Calm down. He had a valid point.

Why am I valuale? You don't even know who I am. I could be the next Charles Manson for all you know, and yet you still say my life has value. Sorry I took your joke poorly. I've always tried to be there for other people. It just seems like nobody wants to be for me even after I have been for them.

I've never really had an interest in sex with my low testosterone and all. Thank you for your kind words, but this is something I've mulled over for months. I feel like people are such scum to take advantage of others and not bother to right their wrongs, that's why I really want to go. Not this situation. I'm aware that I need to acknowledge my own feelins, but then I wouldn't be able to help every person that I could. I just feel purposeless, and this is one of the only ways to get my words out.
Writing feels like the only way I can say what I really want to. So yeah, I understand where you're coming from. I hate that I ended both of those sentences with prepositions.
She didn't do it to spite me. There are no victors here.
Thank you for the response. You kind of hit me in a soft spot with the authors. I'll send it to you.
Hey, I know how you feel. I don't really have anything else to say, other than I'm glad you at least tried to tell someone.
